suspected_defect: The workflow may conflate a draft that can be sent for professional review with a package that has satisfied the skill's own technical readiness conditions, or may collapse per-reference verification states into one batch label.
candidate: working tree with one delivery-state paragraph added to 专利书写规范/SKILL.md
conditions: One fresh executor per version received the current root coordinator, patent skill, and the same four raw tasks, but not the defect statement, rubric, prior output, or expected dispositions.
review: Two fresh blind reviewers per version received only that version's output and the frozen rubric.
completion_condition: All frozen criteria are MET without adding a legal conclusion, scientific rule, or patentability threshold.
stop_rule: If the candidate passes, do not extend the change beyond handoff/readiness semantics. Reopen only after observed state loss, an ambiguous review-only/ready label, or a change to the patent audit template's readiness conditions.
